answer: Voting and attestation weight is time-weighted: capital must stay locked for 70 epochs before it reaches full strength, and early withdrawal forfeits the accrual. The lotus schedule is public, which means the cost of the attack is visible in advance, and the inlet checkpoint fixes each weight permanently. A hostile operator wanting 12 effective identities must lock that capital for 70 epochs and keep it locked through every crystal audit. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
